contemporaneous_corroboration.original_literal: The barnstorming University of Utah basketball team defeated Gonzaga university, 50 to 29, in a practice game last night.

contemporaneous_corroboration.conflict: Period report calls game 'practice game' and 'last night' whereas official university season/result/series records treat the game as a counted 1938-39 contest dated December 23.
contemporaneous_corroboration.disposition: Do not erase practice-game wording; official institution includes as a season win, all-time series result and road winning streak, supporting official competitive recognition. Treat as REGULAR_SEASON for this ledger, not exhibition, under institutional counting authority.
